findings.title: Admit the mirror process before creating or loading its temporary service
findings.evidence: main does not call require_supported or require_or_exit. It creates USER_UNIT_DIR, writes UNIT_PATH and invokes systemctl daemon-reload and start before the service ExecStartPre can admit the host. The later failure also persists evidence. An owned reproduction used DOCKER_HOST=ssh://refused.example and SBARBASE_DOCKER_PROFILE=unknown, patched every service/Docker-observation function to inert doubles, and configured require_supported to raise. Observed admission call count was zero; the unit existed at fake daemon-reload and start; the owned unit directory and owned evidence file were created. Exit was 1, but effects had already occurred. Adding admission only inside unit_text does not meet the process boundary required before files and resources.
findings.reproduction: Import supervised_run_check with lab on sys.path; redirect USER_UNIT_DIR, UNIT_PATH and EVIDENCE to TemporaryDirectory; supply the refused environment; patch systemctl to return successful inert records, wait_for_console to (None,None), journal to empty text and owned_running to False; patch docker_profile.require_supported to raise ProfileError. Run main with --timeout 0 and record the admission call count and UNIT_PATH existence inside fake daemon-reload/start.
findings.requested_change: Call canonical admission before the first service or filesystem effect in main, with a public refusal that does not write evidence or attempt service cleanup. Add an owned fixture for this executable boundary.

findings.title: Preserve declared local profile inputs in the mirrored service
findings.evidence: docker_environment forwards only DOCKER_HOST and DOCKER_CONTEXT. A service does not inherit the caller shell, so SBARBASE_DOCKER_PROFILE, SBARBASE_DOCKER_SOCKET and SBARBASE_DOCKER_DATA_ROOT are lost. With caller inputs local-v1, socket /run/custom.sock, root /srv/custom-docker and matching DOCKER_HOST, from_environment accepts the caller input contract, but the actual forwarded service environment selects the default socket and raises host_endpoint_mismatch. With only a custom data root, forwarded environment is empty and validate_daemon against an inert daemon record for that root raises docker_data_root_mismatch. Thus the mirror cannot verify the declared nondefault local candidate it is intended to mirror. The stale Desktop/context wording at lines 41 to 44 and 188 to 189 also conflicts with the current admission contract.
findings.reproduction: Under patch.dict(os.environ, custom local profile inputs, clear=True), call mirror.docker_environment. Pass its result to docker_profile.from_environment: custom socket produces host_endpoint_mismatch. Repeat with only SBARBASE_DOCKER_DATA_ROOT=/srv/custom-docker, then call validate_daemon using an owned inert Linux daemon record at that root: docker_data_root_mismatch. No daemon query or service operation is needed.
findings.requested_change: Carry the admitted profile, socket and data root into the temporary unit with safe systemd Environment encoding and fixed endpoint semantics. Test nondefault socket and data-root forwarding, including malformed inputs, and align the mirror explanation with local-v1.

requirement_assessment.R1: The actual primary launcher and shared shell capability contract reject unsupported candidate architecture, cgroups, filesystem/root/security/endpoint before Compose startup mutations in the inspected source and replay fixtures.
requirement_assessment.R2: Incomplete because the scoped supervised-check process mutates its unit before admission and loses declared profile inputs at the service boundary. Primary host launcher itself uses POSIX shell, public Linux utilities and Docker/Compose only.
requirement_assessment.R3: Authorized 51 host fixtures and 211 caller tests pass, including actual shell negative replay, tree comparisons and mutation tripwires. Their mirror tests do not exercise the failing process and custom-input cases above.
requirement_assessment.R4: HOST-PREFLIGHT.md and the changed guides preserve the Linux x86_64 local rootful candidate limitation. PROJECT_GOAL remains the broader durable objective. The source does not claim actual clean install, resource enforcement, metadata persistence, reboot, full application recovery or production acceptance.

binary_artifact_preference.basis: Actual baseline source directs raw Compose startup, uses a short checkout bind that can create a missing source, runs the systemd upgrade guard before host capability admission and lets resource snapshot use only Linux/name checks. Current source adds the fixed launcher with canonical preflight, exact existing bind inputs, startup admission before guard/cleanup, shared runtime admission, and replay fixtures. Current source is the better source artifact, but this binary preference is not a passing requirement verdict while the two mirror gaps remain.
binary_artifact_preference.limitation: Compared actual source via git show and working files. No baseline or candidate Docker execution, supported-profile promotion or application equivalence was performed.
